parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the edge instance. In the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotIds
parameters.description:
The list of sub-device IDs. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query device IDs.

> You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
